description: Search the official Griddo documentation for content authors and site administrators (the Griddo backoffice, Author Experience: pages, modules, templates, content types, forms, media gallery, roles, publishing). Returns ranked excerpts with the canonical URL of each page. Use this before answering any question about how to do something in the Griddo backoffice, and cite the URLs you get back. Do NOT use it for developer questions about @griddo/core hooks and components, schema or module code, the Griddo API or the SDK: that is Developer Experience documentation, covered by the separate Griddo DX Docs MCP server.

lang.description: Documentation language. Spanish is the primary, most complete version; pass 'en' when the user writes in English.

query.description: Natural-language query or keywords. Spanish or English.
